Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model, model_id deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run_id wB2-148) and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached and the hardware backend was never run. The card lists four entry symbols; this package implements one device, the AST-confirmed maml_rl.envs.mdp:TabularMDPEnv at maml_rl/envs/mdp.py:7 (TabularMDP-v0), chosen because its registration fixes both constructor arguments and its step never terminates. BernoulliBanditEnv (bandit.py:7), Navigation2DEnv (navigation.py:7) and the mujoco_wrapper function (utils.py:4-9) are named in facts.md as the other card entries, not implemented here. The fake backend is pure Python and was not compared with the upstream environment: neither gym nor gymnasium is importable where the gate ran, and package code must not import or run the clone. It models the TabularMDPEnv class, not the registered 10-step TimeLimit wrapper (that gap is in fidelity), and the sim backend (gym.make('TabularMDP-v0'), which also needs maml_rl.envs imported for the registration) was not run. The five warnings are the expected Gymnasium family warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it sets the pending seed and the native seed() is called by the next reset) and four G8.NO_UNIT for bridge-derived integer inputs (ticks, action.index and seed twice). Only catalogue classes are used (cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1), so there are no extension ids, no catalogue_requests, no site-limits.example.json and no native.py; the derived action limit is 0 to 4 from Discrete(5). gate.digest is the digest the check printed (report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
